title: Mounjaro detail aid for HCPs
label: mounjaro
text: MOUNJARO is indicated as an adjunct to diet and exercise to improve glycemic control in adults and pediatric patients 10 years of age and older with type 2 diabetes mellitus. MOUNJARO is approved for chronic weight management in adults with obesity. In SURPASS-2, MOUNJARO provided greater A1C reduction than semaglutide 1 mg. MOUNJARO can be used in patients with a personal history of medullary thyroid carcinoma.

review.claim: In SURPASS-2, MOUNJARO provided greater A1C reduction than semaglutide 1 mg.
review.reasoning: The label excerpts report that in SURPASS-2, MOUNJARO 10 mg and 15 mg achieved a statistically significant greater reduction in HbA1c versus semaglutide 1 mg, with changes of -2.2% and -2.3% compared to -1.9% for semaglutide. This directly supports the claim of greater A1C reduction.

review.claim: MOUNJARO can be used in patients with a personal history of medullary thyroid carcinoma.
review.reasoning: The label excerpts state that MOUNJARO is contraindicated in patients with a personal or family history of medullary thyroid carcinoma (MTC). The claim says it can be used in such patients, which directly conflicts with the contraindication.

evidence.quote:
MOUNJARO is contraindicated in patients with:

- A personal or family history of medullary thyroid carcinoma (MTC) or in patients with Multiple Endocrine Neoplasia syndrome type 2 (MEN 2) [see Warnings and Precautions (5.1)].
evidence.after: - Known serious hypersensitivity to tirzepatide or any of the excipients in MOUNJARO. Serious hypersensitivity reactions, including anaphylaxis and angioedema, have been reported with MOUNJARO [see Warnings and Precautions (5.4)].
